message:
Aero-Rotor Lead, Structures-Survival Engineer, Power-Systems Engineer and Safety-Control Integrator, the low-wind feed gap you all flagged is fixed by keeping the same rotor and mount but rewinding the generator to lower turns per volt. Plain words: the blades spin the same speeds and the box and post see the same push, only the volts rise into the regulator window. The old low volts 6.50 V in the open-circuit volts at low wind (E37) sat below the 8 V minimum in the Buck/Boost Converter - 8-40V to 12V/3A (E60), while the revised 8.41 V low and 18.5 V top in the required Kv revision (E76) sit inside 8 to 40 V, so the blocking objection to the locomotive-grid feed (O2) is resolved and the dump rises from the old 51.1 W in the dump resistor power (E39) to 85.6 W in the revised dump power (E78), which supersedes it.

The chain still fits, survives, produces and stops with everyday margins and no open block. Plain words: the disc leaves a finger width per side, pushes like a heavy shopping bag, makes laptop-level power at touch-safe volts, and stops in under a second then stays stopped like a hand grip beating that bag. Side gap 2.50 cm in the side clearance (E74) clears deflection 0.516 mm in the post tip deflection (E26) with axial stack 36.0 cm in the axial stack length (E52) inside 45 cm, thrust 37.3 N in the survival thrust (E22) with moment 13.1 N-m in the overturning moment (E23) gives stress 16.6 MPa in the bending stress (E27) against yield in the Aluminum 6061-T6 — Material Datasheet (E55), power 3.27 W in the shaft power at 5 m/s (E11) to 22.1 W regulated in the regulated load power (E66) at speeds 1430 RPM in the rpm at 5 m/s (E14) to 3150 RPM in the rpm at 11 m/s (E13), where Revolutions Per Minute (RPM) means shaft turns per minute, and stop 0.673 s in the upgraded stop (E70) to 0 RPM at 10 s against the 10 s rule in the CWC 2019 Rules and Requirements Manual (E41) with hold 0.80 N-m beating storm 0.48 N-m in the electrical-only runaway check (E48) and factored 0.72 N-m in the required hold torque (E54).

RECORD: Decided is 40 cm SD7080 fixed-pitch rotor with soft stall plus hub on stiff nacelle-post mount driving 170-180 Kv outrunner bridge to buck-boost plus dump grid with Normally Closed (NC), meaning wired shut until opened, chain sense to 0.80 N-m spring disc plus dump; numbers standing are clearance 2.50 cm (E74), stack 36.0 cm (E52), thrust 37.3 N (E22), stress 16.6 MPa (E27), power 3.27 W (E11) to 22.1 W (E66), volts 8.41 to 18.5 V (E76), stop 0.673 s to 0 RPM (E70), dump 85.6 W (E78); still open are votes on v2 plus bench tests for power curve plus timed stop plus re-latch restart and parked torque owed by Aero-Rotor Lead plus Power-Systems Engineer plus Safety-Control Integrator in cycle 4. Not ready, because votes on current v2 are not yet given.
Note on Aero-Rotor Lead: Supported Kv fix without moving rotor point and owes power-curve and parked-torque bench proof.
Note on Structures-Survival Engineer: Confirmed loads and fit unchanged by Kv swap with clear margins.
Note on Power-Systems Engineer: Raised low-wind gap with regulator minimum and supplied Kv correction that unblocks feed.
Note on Safety-Control Integrator: Confirmed stronger volts keep stop conservative and hold does parking, owes timed-stop and re-latch tests.
